Question 11

∬DAAAAAdA,D={(x,z):AAAAAA}

The integral above gives the surface area of the part of the surface y=1xz that lies inside the cylinder x2+z2=2. From left to right, what are the missing expressions?

a
1+x+zx4z4 and x2+z2=2
b
x2+z2xz and x2+z2≤2
c
1xz and x2+z2=2
d
1+x2+z2x4z4 and x2+z2≤2
e
1+x+zx2z2 and x2+z2≥2
